name: removing a link releases what it held
about: Removing a link sends a note off for every note it left sounding, as it delivered them, then CC 123 on every channel it carried a note on.
notes: l1 moves everything onto channel 2, so the held notes are tracked AFTER the ops: what synth was sent, not what kbd played.
t 0, 10, 20: notes 60, 64, 67 (3C, 40, 43) go on, to synth as 91 and to monitor as 90.
t 30: 60 released with 80, so synth gets 81 3C 00.
t 35: 64 released as a note on at velocity 0, which is a release: synth gets 91 40 00.
t 40: unlink l1. Still held at synth: 67 on channel 2. So 81 43 00, then B1 7B 00 (CC 123 is 7B), both at the unlink's time.
Order of the release: note offs by channel then note ascending, then CC 123 by channel ascending. A note off is 8n with velocity 0.
NEGATIVE CONTROL: l2 is not touched. monitor still holds 67 and gets no note off and no CC 123.
NEGATIVE CONTROL t 50: after the unlink kbd reaches monitor only.
